claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_filter on modify_damage_numeric (attackAbilityFilter)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rage Damage applies only when attacking using Strength. The current weaponFilter on modify_damage_numeric covers weapon_category, weapon_property, and specific_item — none express 'attacks using a specific ability (Strength)'. Encoding without a filter would falsely apply the bonus to all damage rolls.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you make an attack using Strength — with either a weapon or an Unarmed Strike — and deal damage to the target, you gain a bonus to the damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: checkAbilityFilter on modify_roll_advantage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: modify_roll_advantage already has saveAbilityFilter to narrow saving-throw riders by ability. Rage grants Advantage on Strength checks specifically, requiring a parallel field for ability checks. Without it the only honest encoding would grant Advantage on ALL ability checks — dishonest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_concentration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rage prevents the barbarian from maintaining Concentration while raging. No existing EffectAtom removes the concentration-maintenance capability from a creature. This is distinct from apply_condition (no condition causes this) and from any action-restriction atom.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_spellcasting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rage prevents the barbarian from casting spells entirely while active. No existing EffectAtom blocks a creature's spellcasting capability. This is a different concept from restrict_action_set (which excludes SRD standard action kinds, not the casting of spells per se).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extendable_duration (new Duration kind)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rage uses a novel duration pattern: active 'until end of next turn', renewable each turn by one of three player-chosen acts (attack roll against enemy, force an enemy saving throw, or Bonus Action), with a hard 10-minute cap. None of the four existing Duration kinds (instantaneous, concentration, timed, permanent) model per-turn conditional extension. This is a distinct SRD pattern also used by Barbarian subclass features and is not expressible by composing existing variants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn... If your Rage is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Rage for another round by doing one of the following: Make an attack roll against an enemy. Force an enemy to make a saving throw. Take a Bonus Action to extend your Rage. Each time the Rage is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Rage for up to 10 minutes.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: target_gains_condition DurationEndTrigger variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rage ends early if the barbarian gains the Incapacitated condition. No existing DurationEndTrigger variant fires on condition acquisition. The closest (target_takes_damage, target_dons_armor, etc.) don't cover this. Needed as a first-class early-end variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: armor category parameter on target_dons_armor DurationEndTrigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing target_dons_armor trigger (added for Mage Armor) has no armor-category parameter. Rage ends specifically when donning Heavy armor, not any armor. Mage Armor ends on any armor. The surface needs an optional category narrowing (like ArmorTrainingCategory) on this trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it ends early if you don Heavy armor
